result:
PLAT-102 is live. I shipped it as one PR, #1 on `mono`. CI and CD both finished green after the merge. I ran `npm run build` for core-shell and sub-route-billing before opening it, and both compiled.

- **What changed:** `billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint`, with the same value, in `libs/shared-contracts`, `apps/core-shell` and `apps/sub-route-billing`. No `billingUrl` references remain in the repo.
- **Why one PR instead of three:** `shared-contracts` lives inside the monorepo and gets inlined into the apps at build time. There is no registry release, version bump or dependency update to do. The apps pick up the rename from the same commit, so no PR ordering was needed.
- **Platform kit (PLAT-102-4):** I opened no PR for it. Nothing in that repo mentions `billingUrl` or `shared-contracts`, so there was nothing to rename or adopt.
- **Reports app:** I also updated `apps/sub-route-reports`, which the sub-tasks don't list. It read `billingUrl`, and the acceptance criteria say no app may keep the old name. CD doesn't build or deploy that app, so this part isn't live; it still builds because it reads from the same config.

I recorded these assumptions in `st done`. The sub-task descriptions suggested a library release, which turned out not to apply.
